title: Use ChatGPT to Plan a Road Trip Route with Stops, Fuel Stops, and Driving Time
facebook: Planning a road trip? Just tell ChatGPT where you're starting, where you want to go, and how far you want to drive each day — it'll map out your route with fuel stops, meal breaks, and cool sights along the way. Here's how to do it in minutes. https://aiworldhq.com/article/use-chatgpt-to-plan-a-road-trip-with-stops-fuel-breaks-and-drive-time
